title: Innate pharma to participate in the H.C. Wainwright 28th annual global investment conference
body_markdown:
** Wed, 09/02/2026 - 07:00


Innate Pharma SA (Euronext Paris: IPH; Nasdaq: IPHA) (“


**Innate**


” or the “


**Company**


”), a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing immunotherapies for cancer patients, today announced that members of its executive team will participate in a fireside chat and one-on-one investor meetings at the following conference:


#### **H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference**


- Dates: September 14–16, 2026


- Location: New York, United States


#### **Fireside chat:**


- Date: September 14, 2026


- Time: 4:30 PM EDT / 10:30 PM CEST


- Webcast:


[Access the webcast](https://journey.ct.events/view/dd50568b-7ec1-45c6-8028-54cda23a92e9)


The link to access the live webcast of the fireside chat will also be available on the


[Events](https://innatepharma2021ir.q4web.com/English/investors/events-and-presentations/default.aspx)


page of the Investors section of Innate Pharma’s website. A replay will be available following the event.
